test_cases.description: Verify that `load_config` is the single shared function called by `af`, `nightshift`, and `spec` entry points and returns an `AgentFoxConfig` instance.
preconditions: A valid `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` exists with minimal defaults
No local `.agent-fox/config.toml` exists in the working directory
Python test environment with all three CLI entry-point modules importable
test_cases.input: Invoke each CLI entry point's config-loading code path in isolation
test_cases.expected: Each of `af`, `nightshift`, and `spec` calls the same `load_config` function; each call returns an `AgentFoxConfig` instance without raising any exception
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
for each cli_module in [af_module, nightshift_module, spec_module]:
    config = cli_module.call_load_config()
    assert isinstance(config, AgentFoxConfig)
assert af_module.LOAD_CONFIG_FUNCTION is nightshift_module.LOAD_CONFIG_FUNCTION is spec_module.LOAD_CONFIG_FUNCTION

test_cases.description: Verify that `load_config` loads global config first, then local config, and merges them with shallow section replacement.
preconditions: `.agent-fox/config.toml` exists in CWD with `[orchestrator]` section having `parallelism = 8`
test_cases.input: Call `load_config()` from the CWD containing the local config
test_cases.expected: Returned `AgentFoxConfig` has `orchestrator.parallelism == 8` (local overrides global); sections not in local config retain global values
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
config = load_config()
assert config.orchestrator.parallelism == 8

test_cases.description: Verify that post-merge result is validated through `AgentFoxConfig` Pydantic model with defaults applied.
preconditions: `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` exists with partial config (some fields omitted)
test_cases.input: Call `load_config()` with a partial global config
test_cases.expected: Returned `AgentFoxConfig` has all fields present; omitted fields have Pydantic default values applied; no `ConfigError` is raised
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
config = load_config()
assert isinstance(config, AgentFoxConfig)
assert config.spec_tool.model == 'claude-sonnet-4-6'  # default value
assert config.spec_tool.auth_method == ''  # default value

test_cases.description: Verify that `load_config` auto-creates `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` with defaults and `0o700` directory permissions when no global config exists.
test_cases.expected: `$HOME/.agent-fox/` directory is created with `0o700` permissions; `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` is created with default content; `load_config` returns a valid `AgentFoxConfig`
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
config = load_config()
global_dir = Path(home()) / '.agent-fox'
global_config = global_dir / 'config.toml'
assert global_dir.exists()
assert oct(global_dir.stat().st_mode & 0o777) == '0o700'
assert global_config.exists()
assert isinstance(config, AgentFoxConfig)

test_cases.description: Verify that `load_config` reads and parses an existing valid global config and uses it as the baseline.
preconditions: `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` exists with valid TOML content including `theme = "light"`
test_cases.expected: Returned `AgentFoxConfig` reflects the global config value `theme = 'light'`; no exception is raised; global config file is not modified
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
config = load_config()
assert config.theme == 'light'
global_config_mtime_before == global_config_mtime_after  # file not modified

test_cases.description: Verify that when `$HOME` cannot be resolved, `load_config` skips global config, emits a debug warning, and returns config from local config or defaults without raising.
preconditions: `$HOME` environment variable is unset or resolves to empty string
`.agent-fox/config.toml` exists in CWD with valid TOML
test_cases.expected: No exception is raised; a DEBUG-level log line mentioning `$HOME` could not be resolved is emitted; returned `AgentFoxConfig` reflects local config values
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with unset_env('HOME'):
    with capture_logs(level='DEBUG') as logs:
        config = load_config()
assert isinstance(config, AgentFoxConfig)
assert any('HOME' in msg and 'could not be resolved' in msg for msg in logs.debug_messages)

test_cases.description: Verify shallow section replacement: local TOML sections entirely replace global sections; absent local sections are inherited unchanged.
test_cases.expected: Merged config has `orchestrator.parallelism == 8`; `orchestrator.timeout` is absent or uses Pydantic default (not global's `30`); `routing.strategy == 'round-robin'` is inherited from global
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
config = load_config()
assert config.orchestrator.parallelism == 8
# timeout from global section is gone (section replaced wholesale)
assert config.routing.strategy == 'round-robin'  # inherited from global

test_cases.description: Verify that when no local config exists, `load_config` uses global config unchanged and emits a debug log line.
test_cases.expected: Returned config has `theme == 'dark'`; a DEBUG log line stating 'No local config found' is emitted
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
with capture_logs(level='DEBUG') as logs:
    config = load_config()
assert config.theme == 'dark'
assert any('No local config found' in msg for msg in logs.debug_messages)

test_cases.description: Verify that `load_config` does NOT deep-merge nested keys within a section — a local section replaces the entire global section including nested keys.
test_cases.expected: `orchestrator.timeout` is not `60` from global; the entire `[orchestrator]` section from local replaced the global section wholesale
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
config = load_config()
assert config.orchestrator.parallelism == 8
# Deep-merge would preserve timeout=60; shallow replacement removes it
assert config.orchestrator.timeout != 60  # or uses Pydantic default, not global value

property_tests.description: For any pair of valid global config G and local config L, shallow section replacement produces a result where every section in L exactly equals the output, every section in G absent from L equals the output, and no section from G also in L appears in the output.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate arbitrary valid TOML dicts G and L using hypothesis strategies: G with keys drawn from known section names (e.g. 'orchestrator', 'routing', 'spec_tool') each mapping to a dict of scalar values; L with a random subset of those sections with different values

property_tests.description: For any sequence of CLI invocations, after the first invocation creates `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`, all subsequent invocations load the existing file without overwriting it.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate a random number of sequential `load_config()` calls (between 2 and 10) in an environment where global config initially does not exist; record file content and mtime after first call

config_content_after_first_call = read_file(global_config_path)

property_tests.invariant_check:

assert resolved == arbitrary_model_string

property_tests.description: For any config file path that exists and contains malformed TOML, `load_config` raises `ConfigError` and never returns a partial `AgentFoxConfig`.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate malformed TOML strings using hypothesis (e.g. truncated TOML, invalid character sequences, unclosed brackets); apply them to either the global or local config path

property_tests.description: For any global or local config file path, symlink detection is applied only to the final file inode; intermediate symlinked directories never cause a rejection.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate config path structures with symlinked intermediate directories but real final files; also generate paths where only the final file is a symlink
property_tests.invariant_check:

        load_config()
    assert 'symlink' in str(exc.exception).lower()
else:  # only intermediate dirs are symlinks

smoke_tests.description: Smoke test for zero-config first run: auto-create global config and succeed end-to-end.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `af` CLI in a clean environment with no existing global or local config and `$HOME` pointing to a temporary directory
mockable: Downstream CLI actions after config loading (to isolate the config loading path)
expected_effects: `$HOME/.agent-fox/` directory is created with `0o700` permissions
`$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` is created with valid default TOML content
A DEBUG log line 'Loaded global config from ...' is emitted
